jsonld_raw.name: MYRRH AND FIG SCENTED CANDLE 200G (7.05 OZ)
jsonld_raw.description: MYRRH AND FIG SCENTED CANDLE 200G (7.05 OZ). A scented candle designed to transform your space into an enveloping atmosphere. Inspired by the light, aromas, and slow pace of a summer in Greece. The juicy sweetness of lychee adds a delicate luminosity, while myrrh reveals a warm, sophisticated facet. Vanilla envelops the composition in a creamy softness, turning any room into a cozy, relaxing sanctuary. A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves. Fruity floral | Warm, comforting, and sweet.
